title: Secure Cloud Networking & Private Access
subtitle: Keep a public user experience while controlling the private data path.
scenario: A browser-based operations platform needed reachable sign-in and application pages while its database and employee documents required tighter network and identity boundaries. Deployment and recovery callers also needed a documented route.
outcome: Reduce exposed data paths without breaking staff access, deployment, monitoring or recovery. Make DNS and caller checks explicit before closing a public endpoint.
flow: Identify each application and deployment caller
Separate shared hub and workload spoke
Verify access before changing public ingress
notes: The dashboard runs a network policy model, not live Azure connectivity probes.
The Terraform module contains a hub/spoke foundation and opt-in private endpoint. It is not applied by CI.
Additional storage/vault endpoints in the source platform remained plans where DNS readiness and cost were unresolved.
boundary: Engineering patterns from an operational platform; this screen shows local code with fictional records.
